name: Adjacent-delta loop is off by one
modeled_on: A time-series / pagination helper computes deltas between adjacent values but walks `range(len(values))` and reads `values[i + 1]` — IndexError on the final element. Another instance of the classic off-by-one, in a different domain than the slider entry to prove the rule generalizes.
ground_truth: Iterate `range(len(values) - 1)` so the last element has no successor.
